prompt.zh-CN: 【时间压力】CEO通知：由于年度预算规划，迁移上线日期被提前两周，现在只剩6周时间。
prompt.en-US: 【Timeline Pressure】The CEO announces that, due to annual budget planning, the migration go-live has been pulled in by two weeks — only 6 weeks remain.

prompt.zh-CN: 【预算冻结】财务总监通知：超出已批预算的额外资源申请一律暂停，需要重新证明必要性。
prompt.en-US: 【Budget Freeze】The Finance Director announces that all additional resource requests beyond the approved budget are suspended until necessity is re-proven.

prompt.zh-CN: 【组织缺口】运营副总裁通知：数据负责人临时休假，端到端的数据责任暂时悬空。
prompt.en-US: 【Ownership Gap】The VP of Operations announces that the data owner is on leave, leaving end-to-end data responsibility temporarily vacant.

prompt.zh-CN: 【回滚要求】CTO要求：在批准切换前，必须提交一次完整的回滚演练记录。
prompt.en-US: 【Rollback Requirement】The CTO requires a full rollback-drill record before approving cutover.
